newsitem.title: USA: S3 says Sharp to use accelerator.
newsitem.headline: S3 says Sharp to use accelerator.

text.p: S3 Inc, a maker of products that speed computer video and graphics, said electronics maker Sharp Corp will use S3's Aurora64V+ accelerator in its new line of notebook personal computers.

"Aurora64V+'s unique design, power management and display capabilities are enabling us to secure major design wins with industry leaders such as Sharp Computer," said Gary Johnson, S3 chief executive.
The Aurora64V+ with S3's "DuoView" technology puts dual display capability and a true 64-bit graphics into notebook PCs for the first time, S3 said.
